description: This Java class 'SensorLogger' manages sensor data logging for a vehicle ECU system, including initializing log files, writing sensor data lines, and handling sensor name labels based on debug modes.

classes.name: SensorLogger
classes.description: A utility class for logging sensor data to a file, including initialization, data writing, and sensor name management based on debug modes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor logger, sets up a listener for sensor updates, and starts logging if not already running.

methods.name: writeSensorLogLine
methods.description: Writes a line of current sensor values to the log file, including timestamp.

methods.name: startSensorLogFile
methods.description: Creates and writes headers to a new sensor log file, including version info and sensor labels.

methods.name: getSensorName
methods.description: Returns the display name of a sensor, with special labels for debug float and int fields depending on debug mode.

methods.name: isPidDebugMode
methods.description: Determines if the current debug mode is a PID debug mode based on hardcoded values.
